title: Patch APK
desc: Builds an authorized lab variant and injects the in-process gadget. Original store APK stays untouched.

title: Regenerate Scripts
desc: Rebuilds the JS toolkit for the same gadget without packing the APK again.

title: Analyze APK
desc: Parses the package into a surface map: framework, components, schemas, native libs, defense fingerprints.

title: Static Audit
desc: Walks manifest flags, WebView references, signing block, DEX strings. Findings get FH-IDs.

title: Exploitability Radar
desc: Calibrates reportability. One exported editor is MEDIUM, not a fake critical.

title: Select Module
desc: Opens the grouped deck. Starred rows match this binary.

title: Shell
desc: Interactive operator shell against the instrumented lab process.

title: Session History
desc: Lists prior sessions and exported evidence IDs.

title: Backups
desc: Stores lab-build artifacts and script packs.

title: Rollback
desc: Returns the workspace to the last clean lab variant.

title: Update Check
desc: Checks the operator tree version. Does not phone home from the target.

title: Dependency Check
desc: Verifies host-side tools the operator console expects.

title: Clean
desc: Removes patched lab APKs from the workspace.

title: Exit
desc: Ends the operator session. Uninstall the lab variant when done.

title: BuildConfig Auditor
desc: Reads build flavor, debug flags, and compile-time constants.

title: Live Interaction Tracer
desc: Logs UI-driven calls while you tap. Empty log means you did not hit that surface.

title: Auto Recon
desc: First-pass inventory: activities, services, receivers, providers, deeplink hosts.

title: Command Center
desc: Session desk. Surfaces the start-here list for this binary.

title: File Explorer
desc: Browses app-private paths the instrumented process can already see.

title: Data Dumper
desc: Exports prefs, databases, and caches the lab process can read.

title: Hooking Console
desc: Loads or unloads a module without leaving the session.

title: Intent Interceptor
desc: Captures intents the lab app sends or receives while you use it.

title: Deeplink Fuzzer
desc: Exercises declared scheme + host + pathPrefix entries from the surface map.

title: Schema Fuzzer
desc: Walks custom URI schemas found in the manifest and string pool.

title: Content Provider Probe
desc: Queries exported providers the map already listed.

title: Intent Hunter
desc: Capture and replay against components that are exported on this build.

title: Auto-Exploit Chain
desc: Only stitches steps that match this surface. No invented components.

title: Provider confused-deputy check
desc: Tests whether an exported provider accepts a call the app did not intend to honor.

title: Native Function Tracer
desc: Traces .so exports the binary actually ships.

title: Service / AIDL perm check
desc: Checks exported services for missing permission gates.

title: WebView bridge deep-dive
desc: Inspects JS bridges when the binary actually references them.

title: Request intelligence
desc: Classifies requests the lab process makes while you walk flows.

title: Token dumper
desc: Records tokens the process already holds after you log in.

title: Native secret hunter
desc: Sweeps .so string tables for high-entropy blobs.

title: JNI RegisterNatives dumper
desc: Dumps dynamically registered JNI methods.

title: Memory forensics
desc: Snapshot of selected heaps after a gesture, not a full-phone dump.

title: FULL AUTO (surface-aware)
desc: Start-here loadout. Only modules that matched the map.

title: TLS pinning observer
desc: Records pinning libraries. Not a universal kill-switch.

title: RASP / anti-tamper observer
desc: Heartbeats and tamper checks observed and scored honestly.

title: Play Integrity inspector
desc: Client-side Integrity calls and what the app does with the token.
